grains.RAW.PRODUCTION_LINES: one row per garment production line (one line type at one city)
grains.RAW.LINE_DAILY: one row per line per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.LINE_QUALIFICATION: one row per line (backup machine qualification snapshot)
grains.CURATED.CONSTRAINT_CAUSES: one row per stoppage root cause

metrics.Plan Attainment: 100 * SUM(UNITS_COMPLETED) / SUM(COMMITTED_UNITS), pieces completed over pieces committed
metrics.Queue Hours per Piece: SUM(QUEUE_HOURS) / SUM(WIP_ARRIVALS), WIP queue hours per piece released to the line

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.stoppage_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(line stoppage in next 7 days) per line, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day network-wide plan-attainment FORECAST; throughput gap ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.PRODUCTION_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic line stoppage SOPs (one per line type and cause)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.PRODUCTION_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.PRODUCTION_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, stoppage, cause and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (KPIs, daily plan attainment, stoppages by line, stoppage risk, IoT message count) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: IoT Core rule -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_ALARM_ALERT logs new ALARM readings to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
